competencies.name: Shipping LLM features
competencies.posting_quote: You have shipped at least one LLM feature to production users.

competencies.name: Evaluation discipline
competencies.posting_quote: You measure quality with evals, not vibes.

competencies.name: Clear communication
competencies.posting_quote: You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues.

evidence.text: Led Lantern, an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices.

sources.quote: Led Lantern, an LLM invoice-extraction pipeline

evidence.text: Lantern cut manual data entry from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per invoice.

sources.quote: cut manual entry from 11 to 2 minutes per invoice

evidence.text: Built a 300-invoice golden set and ran it on every prompt change before release.

sources.quote: 300-invoice golden set, run on every prompt change

questions.text: Tell me a bit about yourself and what brings you to this role.
follow_ups: Ask what they enjoy most about building LLM products.

questions.text: Tell me about an LLM feature you shipped to real users. How did you know it worked?
follow_ups: Ask for the metric that proved it worked.
Ask how they caught regressions before release.

questions.text: Why Northwind Labs, and why now?
follow_ups: Ask what they would want to learn in their first three months.

c1.1: No shipped feature, or only demos.
c1.3: Shipped a feature but cannot say what changed for users.
c1.5: Shipped to real users and names the measured outcome.

c2.5: Describes a repeatable eval set run before each release.

c3.5: Clear, concrete and adapted to the listener.
